blocks.text: Repeat the names of these fruits:

There are many different kinds of fruits. All of them are good for your health. They contain minerals and vitamines. Oranges and lemons contain vitamine “C”, so, if you drink orange juice you’re taking some grams of that vitamine. Now, let’s talk about the color of some fruits:

items: – Apples are red, green, and sometimes yellow.
– Pears are green or yellow.
– Grapes are green, purple, and sometimes yellow like apples.
– Oranges are green, yellow and orange, too.

items.q: 1) Are apples blue or orange?
items.a: They are neither blue nor orange.

items.q: – What color are the apples?
2) Are pears red or purple?
– What color are the pears?

blocks.text: I like either (coffee or tea). → I like neither coffee nor tea.

items.q: Jenny wants to eat either spaghetti or salad.
I will study (either in China or in Japan).
We have written (either to Louis or to Douglas).
She knows how to speak (either French or English).
They have (either a yacht or a boat).
The poor man can (either swim or sail).

items: *Harry:* Is grape juice or apple juice your favorite drink?
*Caroline: Neither* grape juice *nor* apple juice. My favorite drink is orange juice.
*Harry:* So, you *rarely get* a cold.
*Caroline:* That’s true! I *seldom catch* a cold.
*Harry:* Is grape juice or apple juice your favorite drink?
*Harry:* So, you rarely get a cold.
*Caroline:* That’s true! I __________ *catch* a cold.

Do you prefer the blue pants or the black ones? I prefer neither the blue pants nor the black ones.

Will you buy the green or the red car? I will buy neither the green nor the red one.
Will you go to John’s or Mary’s party? I will go neither to John’s nor Mary’s party.

blocks.text: Write a sentence from these forms. (Use “either … or”)

items: He wants to eat fish. He wants to eat meat.
He wants to eat *either* fish *or* meat.

items.q: He wants to drink lemonade. He wants to drink milk.
I like apples. I like oranges.
You wish to buy a house. You wish to buy a farm.
We bought the stamp. We bought the envelope.
Orlando is in Florida. Inyus is in Florida.
Margaret has eaten a hamburger. Margaret has eaten a hamburger.

items: When did they come? (last night – last Saturday)
They came either last night or last Saturday.

items.q: Where will they travel? (Puerto Rico – Panama)
What does she always drink? (some lemonade – coke)
How do you like your coffee? (with cream – without cream)
What didn’t Bill eat? (potatoes – tomatoes)
What did he drink? (orange juice – milk)

items: *A boy:* Do you want to go to the beach?
*A girl:* No, thanks. I prefer to stay alone.
*The boy:* When do you want to go to the movies on Saturday or on Sunday?
*The girl:* I want to go to the movies neither on Saturday nor on Sunday.
*The boy:* Oh! What a pity!
